# {{ site_name }}

> A read-only archive of public mailing lists, indexed from their public-inbox mirrors.

{% if content_signal %}
Content-Signal: {{ content_signal }}

{% endif %}
Every message and thread page has a Markdown version at the same URL plus `.md`, for agents and other tools. It carries the mail as plain text under the same address hiding as the HTML page: sender addresses are hidden unless they are allowlisted, and Message-IDs are not shown. Each Markdown page names its HTML page as canonical.

## URL shapes

{% for label, path, md_path in shapes %}
- {{ label }}: `{{ site_base }}{{ path }}` (Markdown: `{{ site_base }}{{ md_path }}`)
{% endfor %}

## Discovery

- [Sitemap]({{ site_base }}/sitemap.xml): the HTML pages, except single messages. The Markdown pages are not listed; add `.md` to a message or thread page URL.
- [Message sitemap]({{ site_base }}/messages-sitemap.xml): single-message threads, and threads still being backfilled. A message in a thread is listed through its thread page.
- [Privacy]({{ site_base }}/privacy): what is hidden and why.
